One individual stands upright in deeper water to the left of the wave’s peak, shirtless and facing toward the shore.
A third person crouches on a dark-colored board near the wave’s lip, knees bent and torso leaning forward.

alternative_interpretations: This is simply a recreational beach scene with no intended symbolic meaning; the composition reflects typical coastal tourism photography.
limitations: No textual labels, signage, or cultural markers confirm intentional symbolism; interpretation relies on conventional metaphorical associations.
